## Projects

### AstroRoni

- URL: https://astroroni.com
- Category: Full-Stack Platform
- Year: 2025
- Role: Full-Stack Developer
- Stack: Next.js, Python, Flask, MongoDB, NASA Ephemeris

Full-stack Vedic astrology platform with NASA ephemeris-based Kundli generation, 36 Guna matching, numerology, and NRI-friendly consultation booking.

**Challenge:** Vedic astrology requires accurate planetary position calculations rooted in complex astronomical data. Existing platforms were outdated, inaccurate, or lacked the modern UX needed to make astrology services accessible — especially for NRI users across global time zones.

**Approach:** Built a comprehensive platform with a computation engine powered by NASA ephemeris data for precise planetary calculations. Developed modules for Kundli generation, 36 Guna matching for marriage compatibility, Panchang (daily tithi, nakshatra, yoga), horoscope predictions, numerology grid analysis, and a numerology calculator. Integrated NRI-friendly consultation booking with global timezone support.

**Outcome:** Launched a production platform at astroroni.com offering six free report types — Kundli, Kundli Matching, Panchang, Horoscope, Numerology Grid, and Numerology Calculator — alongside premium consultation services. Trusted by thousands of users with scientifically accurate Vedic calculations.

### RiskRadar

- URL: https://riskradar.piyushpaul.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Piyush800x/risk-radar-web
- Category: Security Tool
- Year: 2024
- Role: Full-Stack Developer
- Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Flask, Python, MongoDB

Sophisticated vulnerability detection and alerting software that tracks CVEs and notifies users when their products are affected.

**Challenge:** Development teams need real-time awareness of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) affecting their tech stack. Manually tracking security advisories across fragmented sources is impractical, error-prone, and leaves critical windows of exposure.

**Approach:** Engineered a product vulnerability assessment platform with a Next.js/TypeScript frontend and Flask API backend. Built CVE database ingestion pipelines, product-to-vulnerability mapping logic, and automated email notification dispatching when critical vulnerabilities are detected in registered products.

**Outcome:** Deployed a fully functional vulnerability scanner at riskradar.piyushpaul.com. Automated CVE tracking and alerting pipeline that keeps development teams informed in real-time, significantly reducing manual monitoring effort and improving incident response time.

### HTTP Header Security Analyzer API

- GitHub: https://github.com/Piyush800x/header-analyzer
- Category: Full-Stack API / Security Tool
- Year: 2026
- Role: Full-Stack Developer
- Stack: Python, Flask, Gunicorn, Docker, pytest

Production-ready Flask REST API that audits website HTTP security headers, scores sites out of 100 with A–F grading, and returns severity-ranked remediation recommendations.

**Challenge:** Most developers overlook HTTP security headers during deployment, leaving sites vulnerable to XSS, clickjacking, MIME sniffing, and transport-layer attacks.

**Approach:** Built a REST API with Flask Blueprints auditing 8 OWASP-recommended security headers — CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options — assigning severity levels (HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW) and point-based scores. Implemented built-in rate limiting (30 req/min per IP), CORS support, structured JSON error handling, and a health check endpoint. Deployed with Gunicorn and Docker with 12 unit tests.

**Outcome:** Delivered a containerized, production-grade security auditing API with a 0–100 scoring system, A–F grading, and per-header remediation recommendations linked to MDN documentation.

## Hackathon Projects

### ARTA — Autonomous Red Team Agent

- GitHub: https://github.com/Piyush800x/arta
- Category: Cybersecurity / AI Agent
- Year: 2026
- Award: 🏆 MLH Hack Days Winner
- Stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Nmap, SQLite, Puppeteer, Metasploit

Autonomous penetration testing pipeline powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash — multi-agent system for reconnaissance, CVE analysis, and exploit validation.

**Challenge:** Manual penetration testing is slow and resource-intensive. Security teams need automation for reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, and reporting phases to identify critical security gaps in minutes, not days.

**Approach:** Built a multi-agent orchestration system using Gemini 2.0 Flash to handle the entire offensive pipeline. Specialized agents for Recon (Nmap parsing), Vulnerability Analysis (live NVD API integration), and Automated Reporting. Implemented real-time SSE dashboard in Next.js for monitoring agent reasoning and tool usage.

**Outcome:** Won MLH Hack Days. Delivered a tool producing severity-ranked findings and professional remediation reports with zero manual intervention. Demonstrated against Metasploitable targets.

---

### PacketForge

- GitHub: https://github.com/samiranpal2004/PacketForge-main
- Category: Network Security / Systems
- Year: 2026
- Award: 🥈 Synchronicity S2 — 1st Runner-Up (Jadavpur University)
- Team: Team Aloo Siddo
- Stack: C, DPDK, QEMU/KVM, FastAPI, Python, Lua, WebSocket

DPDK-based dual-NIC packet scrubber that detects and drops DDoS traffic at line rate — sustaining 470K packets/sec.

**Challenge:** DDoS attacks overwhelm servers by exhausting CPU and bandwidth at the kernel level. Traditional software firewalls are too slow — they hand packets to the OS kernel which processes them one by one, making mitigation reactive and CPU-intensive.

**Approach:** Built a dual-NIC DPDK scrubber running inside QEMU/KVM VMs. Packets arrive at the ingress DPDK port (bypassing the kernel entirely), get classified by a Lua rule engine, and are either dropped or forwarded at 200K–470K pps. Added a FastAPI telemetry server with real-time WebSocket streaming to a live dashboard, and a Python CLI supporting zero-downtime CIDR block/unblock with sub-millisecond rule application. Lua rules hot-reload atomically.

**Outcome:** Achieved 1st Runners Up at Synchronicity S2. Demonstrated a live DDoS flood scenario — SYN, UDP, and ICMP floods hitting 470K pps — with instant 100% drop rate upon a single CLI command.

---

### NeighbourNet

- GitHub: https://github.com/sudipta57/NeighbourNet2
- Category: Mesh Network / Disaster Communication
- Year: 2026
- Award: 🥈 MLH HackTropica — 1st Runner-Up
- Team: Team Aloo Siddo
- Stack: React Native, FastAPI, Supabase, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Bluetooth, WiFi Direct

Offline mesh SOS communication system with on-device AI triage for disaster scenarios where cellular infrastructure fails.

**Challenge:** Traditional communication infrastructure (cellular, internet) is the first thing to fail during natural disasters like floods or cyclones. This leaves victims unable to send SOS messages and rescue teams unable to coordinate or triage needs in real-time.

**Approach:** Developed an offline-first mesh networking system that turns Android devices into relay nodes using BLE and WiFi Direct. SOS messages hop phone-to-phone without internet, are triaged on-device using a multilingual keyword-scoring engine, and automatically sync to a cloud-based coordinator dashboard when any device in the mesh gains connectivity.

**Outcome:** Achieved 1st Runners Up at HackTropica 2K26 (MLH). Delivered a functional prototype including a React Native mobile app, FastAPI backend with Gemini 2.5 Flash for cloud-side triage, and a real-time Next.js dashboard for disaster response coordinators.
